EmailTemplate.name: OrgPlus RealTime – Default Field Error
EmailTemplate.subject: OrgPlus RealTime – Default Field Error
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
To resolve the error "Error in saving fields. Please contact administrator," please follow the below steps:
Go into the Administration Tab Click the Edit Organization Icon Select Edit Default Field Add any field Save
Once this process is completed, you will be able to map fields.
Please let us know if we can be of further assistance. Thank you for allowing Insperity to serve you.
Thank you,
